desc: Derive and prove the cost formula: cost(l,r) = sum of (prefix max − a[i]), verify against examples.
Design sliding-window approach with monotonic stack of (value, count) levels and two pointers.
Handle window shrink efficiently via front-group count decrement in the deque structure.
Implement `countNonDecreasingSubarrays` with two-pointer + monotonic deque, cost = Σ level·cnt − window_sum, push-with-rollback on overflow, accumulating R − L per left endpoint.
Test edge cases: n=1, strictly increasing, strictly decreasing, k=1, large values, and validate against brute-force O(n²) reference on random small arrays.
